d: WSP in the Middle East is seeking a highly experienced Principal Engineer – Vertical Transportation (VT) with a strong background in the lift and escalator industry, and prior experience in vertical transportation consultancy roles. The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience and demonstrable expertise in lift traffic simulation and lift and escalator system design.

The successful candidate must be fully conversant with the EN 81 suite of codes, have a working knowledge of the ASME series of codes, and demonstrate a thorough understanding of local Middle East building codes.

In this role, you will be responsible for developing vertical transportation design concepts, including the calculation of the number, size, and speed of lifts for a wide variety of building types. You will also be expected to prepare design stage reports, drawings, and technical specifications, and participate in client and design team meetings as required.
q: Degree in lift and escalator engineering or electrical/mechanical engineering
Extensive experience designing VT systems for various building types
Strong knowledge of VT codes, standards, and local building regulations
Proven ability to manage multiple deadlines and project reviews
Detail-oriented with excellent analytical and organizational skills
Solid understanding of standard engineering practices and techniques
Strong technical delivery and problem-solving skills
Excellent written and spoken English, with effective client communication skills
Team player with good collaboration and adaptability to changing demands
Sound judgment based on significant industry experience
Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.

Join our close-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.
With us, you can. Apply today.
r: li
Advanced knowledge and experience in utilizing lift traffic design software (Elevate), CAD, BIM, Revit, Microsoft Office suite of programs.
li
To produce efficient VT solutions for the client.
li
Responsible for producing technical reports to illustrate the design to the client and his representatives.
li
Responsible for attending and coordinating meetings with the project design team, VT supplier, and specialist subcontractors to ensure that the intended design is appropriately implemented.
li
Liaison and coordination with all applicable Local Authority Departments and stakeholders to obtain approval at all stages of the project.
li
Coordination with other Discipline Engineers (Architectural, Structural, Telecoms, IT, Mechanical, and Electrical) as applicable.
li
Participation in design review/clarification meetings and workshops, and client presentations.
li
Liaise with VT suppliers to ensure adherence to standards and the scope of works required by the client.

d: Welcome to Hyatt Regency! One of Hyatt's very first brands of hotels and resorts, Hyatt Regency brings people together and fosters connections at more than 175 Hyatt Regency hotels and resorts worldwide.

The alluringly modern Hyatt Regency Oryx Doha is conveniently located close to Hamad International Airport and just a few minutes away from the heart of the city, the palm-fringed Corniche, National Museum of Qatar and Doha’s business district. With its contemporary architecture and warm hospitality, the hotel creates the perfect ambience for business and leisure travelers through stress-free environment designed for productivity and peace of mind with the tools to stay connected and energized.

As part of signature experience through their Hyatt Regency journey, our guests are connected to regionally inspired dining experiences through a collection of award-winning restaurants serving delicacies that satisfy any palate. From the delectable range of tapas and fine premium beverages at The Cellar to the delicious Lebanese fare at Al Nafourah Garden and the international buffet at Choices, our six F&B outlets serve cuisine to suit all tastes and occasions.

We are looking for colleagues who can quickly perpetuate a culture that embraces modern design and exceptional service, who have a passion for outstanding customer-tailored service that is both unique and authentic. We believe our guests select our hotel because of our caring and attentive colleagues who provide efficient service and create seamless, intuitive, signature experience making our guests’ stay free from stress and filled with success.

As a Waiter / Waitress you will be responsible for hosting and serving the guests in our award-winning restaurants, creating lasting memories through exchange of engaging dialogues and stories with our guests during their dining experience. You will bring our restaurant concepts to life by using your personal flair and style while interacting with our guests.
q: Exceptional interpersonal skills showing care for and ability to connect with our guests
International experience in luxury hotel brands demonstrating adaptability to a range of cultures and environments

Desire to constantly learn and ambition to grow
Competitive tax free salary and benefits
Opportunities for career growth within the global company

d: We hold significant high-value inventory: mobile devices, consumer electronics, ICT equipment and network devices, plus stock we store for partners. We're now investing in warehouse automation. We're looking for an experienced warehouse leader to run the operation today and build the automated warehouse of tomorrow.
q: 7–10 years in the warehousing industry (large distribution centres or warehousing operators), including 3+ years managing teams of 15 or more.
Hands-on WMS experience, plus involvement in warehouse automation projects.
A strong record in inventory accuracy and stock control; experience with serialised or high-value goods is a plus.
Comfort with data: advanced Excel, dashboards and system-driven decisions.
Experience leading multicultural teams across office and floor roles.
A bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business or Engineering; CILT, CSCP, CPIM or CIPS preferred.
r: li
Run end-to-end warehouse operations, from receiving to returns, for retail, B2B and ICT distribution, and oversee e-commerce inventory, meeting agreed turnaround times.
li
Protect high-value stock through tight inventory control, serial/IMEI traceability and accurate reconciliation, including partner stock.
li
Build and lead the warehouse automation roadmap (WMS, RFID, automated storage and handling) from business case to go-live.
li
Own warehouse risks: spot them early and raise them with facts and solutions.
li
Lead a team of 15–20 office and floor staff with a safety-first culture.
li
Manage the warehouse budget and drive measurable improvements in cost, accuracy and productivity.
x: Lead a warehouse automation journey from the start.
Make a visible impact in a high-value, fast-moving operation.
